name: Tweetify
description: Condense text into a punchy post under 280 characters
promptTemplate:
Condense the following text into a single punchy social media post under 280 characters. Keep it engaging and natural, no hashtag spam (max 2 hashtags, only if they fit):

"{{input}}"

IMPORTANT: Return ONLY the post text. Do NOT include any introductory notes, explanations, character counts, or quotes around the post.
